rationale: Parth brings hands-on mechanical and hardware testing expertise from Tesla's humanoid robotics program, while 马千里 brings deep motion planning and trajectory optimization skills from Woven by Toyota and Motional. Together they span the hardware-to-software pipeline for robotics systems—Parth's testing rigor on physical platforms complements 马千里's algorithmic work on collision checking and path planning, making them natural collaborators on any robotics engineering challenge.
intro_message: Parth Behani, meet 马千里 — you're both building the mechanical and algorithmic foundations of modern robotics, and your hardware-testing and motion-planning expertise could unlock something interesting together.
